name: AndroidWorld
summary: Google Research environment and benchmark for autonomous Android control agents: 116 hand-crafted tasks across 20 apps on a live emulator.
description: Tasks are instantiated with random parameters, giving millions of unique variations with durable reward signals; also supports MiniWoB++ web tasks. Runs against an Android emulator (Pixel 6, API 33) with ~2 GB memory and 8 GB disk; experimental Docker support. Links to a public leaderboard spreadsheet from the project site.
